DuneSea_Text_Npc0.en: Water is gold here. Watch your\nsupplies.
DuneSea_Text_Npc0.fr: L'eau est de l'or ici. Surveille\ntes provisions.

DuneSea_Text_Npc1.en: TRAPINCH waits in a pit. Do not\nfall in.
DuneSea_Text_Npc1.fr: KRAKNOIX attend dans un trou.\nNe tombe pas dedans.

DuneSea_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: Two FRESH WATERs and I will give\nyou the sand that sings.
DuneSea_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Deux EAUX FRAÎCHES et je te donne\nle sable qui chante.

DuneSea_Text_Quest0_Done.fr: De l'eau ! Prends ce SABLE DOUX.

DuneSea_Text_Quest0_MissT.en: Two FRESH WATERs, please. The cafe\nsells them.
DuneSea_Text_Quest0_MissT.fr: Deux EAUX FRAÎCHES, s'il vous\nplaît. Le café en vend.

DuneSea_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
DuneSea_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

DuneSea_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

DuneSea_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
DuneSea_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
